tests.title: Rational LDL completeness audit
tests.description: Checks zero pivots, singular PSD matrices, exact reconstruction, and certificate bit-growth obligations.

tests.title: Exact theta primal-dual audit
tests.description: Checks one fixed Lovasz-theta primal/dual normalization, exact feasibility, and exact objective equality.

tests.title: Dual theta-gap UNSAT audit
tests.description: Checks graph binding, the clause target, and the one-sided implication theta upper bound below target implies UNSAT.

tests.title: Disjoint-union amplification audit
tests.description: Checks variable offsetting, absence of cross edges, alpha additivity, theta additivity, and uniform family generation.

tests.title: Certified finite collision audit
tests.description: Requires opposite exact alpha labels, equal positive targets, and equal exact theta certificates without synthetic witnesses.

tests.title: Conditioned rational reconstruction audit
tests.description: Checks Slater margins, objective margins, rational rounding, eigenvalue perturbation, and final LDL bit length.
